in_marathi.name: Faalgun
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Sharp Arrows
in_marathi.long_meaning: Faalgun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Faalgun is the name of the Hindu god of archery. He is also known as Shanmukha or Kartikeya and is the son of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati. Faalgun is considered the commander of the army of the gods and is worshipped for his courage, wisdom, and strength.
